CM-R1_truncation_without_certificate.note: HC-1: t0=1 hides p's t=0 criteria edit on j; no Ŝ0 -> remainder unbounded

CM-R2_clean_bootstrap_zero_remainder.note: fresh a2, j2, rubric r issued and sealed by independent d at t0; cone has no pre-t0 history

CM-R3_bootstrap_leak_via_uncovered_relay.note: bootstrap of {a2,j2,r} alone is not enough: q enters the cone in-window, its pre-t0 controller p is unrecorded

CM-R4_channel_missing_in_bound.note: bound attests credential/capability/artifact of j but not criteria; uncovered channel = remainder

CM-R5_loose_bound_blocks_without_conflic.note: Ŝ0 says p *could* have edited rubric r; sound but loose -> block, reason BOUND, not CONFLICT

CM-R6_state_dependent_reset_unsound.note: revocation triggered by a *bounded* token fires only in Ŝ and erases p's true token -> false CLEAR

CM-R7_self_attested_bound.note: certificate for Ŝ0 issued by p, a member of P_x

CM-R8_certified_actual_pre_state_witness.note: certified *actual* pre-t0 token is a witness, not merely a bound
